articles.summary: CHARLESTON, W.Va. – United Bankshares, Inc. (“United”) (NASDAQ: UBSI), the parent company of United Bank, held a grand opening ceremony for its new operations center in Charleston on Thursday, marking a continued effort to streamline operations and strengthen its service network.
articles.title: United Bank Opens New Operations Center In Charleston

articles.summary: WASHINGTON – United Bank, a subsidiary of United Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: UBSI), today announced that Phil Poliquin has joined the Bank as senior vice president and managing director of Government Contracting (GovCon), leading the next phase of growth for United’s GovCon business across the Bank’s footprint.
articles.title: United Bank Hires Phil Poliquin to Lead Government Contracting Business

articles.summary: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. – A partnership of nearly 35 years will continue as the West Virginia University Department of Intercollegiate Athletics and United Bank have agreed to a five-year sponsorship extension, keeping the bank as the exclusive financial institution of WVU Athletics.
articles.title: WVU Athletics and United Bank Renew Partnership
